missions.done_text: Fool! You have already finished this Yakuza job!

plan.text: GET ZITZAKI!
Kosai! Johnny Zoo here. The Zaibatsu have discovered our experiments with Doctor ZitZaki. He needs help - and fast. Collect the marked car parked at City University.
Doctor ZitZaki is waiting in the District Hospital. Don't keep him waiting.
Doctor ZitZaki is wary of strangers, Kosai. Sound the horn so he knows it is safe.
Good. Bring Doctor ZitZaki directly to the new J-Lab.
Doctor ZitZaki is safe and Yakuza drug production can continue. Here is $20,000 for a job well done. Perhaps we can work together again, Kosai.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: GET ZITZAKI!

missions.done_text: Fool! You have already finished this Yakuza job!

plan.text: BANK ROBBERY!
Ah, Kosai! Johnny Zoo here. I am having money illegally transferred to my bank account and I need you to help my inside man, Hiroshi. Take the vehicle and firepower provided.
Hiroshi will have moved the money into my account by the time you reach the City Bank to pick him up.
Hiroshi will not come out until the two City Bank Guards are out of the way. What are you waiting for, Kosai?
SHIT! Someone tipped off the Cops, Kosai! Your Cop Wanted Level has risen. Here's $5,000 so you can respray the car to throw the Cops off your trail.
Nice respray, Kosai. Now get your ass to the Safehouse to collect your reward.
Bribing Cops is a smart way to reduce your Cop Wanted Level, Kosai. Now go to the Safehouse to collect your reward.
Excellent, Kosai! Now bring the car back to the Safehouse.
Thank you for your efforts, Kosai. It is with gratitude I give you $20,000.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: BANK ROBBERY!

missions.done_text: Fool! You have already finished this Yakuza job!

plan.text: HAPPY GAS SMASH!
Hi, Kosai, it's Johnny Zoo. The Loonies still owe me money for merchandise. Get some wheels, get to the City University and GET MY DOLLARS!
Sound your horn, Kosai, the Loonies are expecting you.
Kill the crazies, Kosai!
You need more dollars to rig the Van. Might I humbly suggest a killing spree?
Good, you have enough dollars to arm the Ice-Cream Van. Get to it!
Drive the Ice-Cream Van to the Loony Asylum. Once you get inside destroy their Happy Gas tanks.
Arm the Ice-Cream Van bomb then escape the Asylum - fast.
Clearly you are too weak to complete even the simplest of tasks, Kosai. A pity.
JOB FAILED!

missions.title: HAPPY GAS SMASH!

missions.done_text: Fool! You have already finished this Yakuza job!

plan.text: GET GAMA REI!
Hi, Kosai, it's Johnny Zoo. Gama Rei has to leave the City Hospital - fast. He's in plastic surgery so you need a Medicar.
Have patience, Kosai. Gama Rei only just got his new face.
Gama Rei must be taken to the Safehouse before the Loonies dispatch Assassins. Move it!
Gama Rei has stolen Loony secrets so they want him bad. Watch his ass, Kosai.
Gama Rei is important to us, Kosai. We are most pleased by your performance. Here - have $40,000.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: GET GAMA REI!

missions.done_text: Fool! You have already finished this Yakuza job!

plan.text: SWAT VAN SWIPE!
Hi, Kosai, it's Johnny Zoo. The authorities have impounded my favorite car and I want you to steal me a SWAT Van as compensation.
You steal well, Kosai. The Yakuza will have many jobs for someone with your talents. For now, $60,000 should see you right.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: SWAT VAN SWIPE!

missions.done_text: You are in error. This Zaibatsu job has already been completed.

plan.text: COP CAR CRUSH!
Hey, Gecko, it's Trey Welsh. An informer is selling Zaibatsu secrets to the Cops. There's a Cop Car parked down at the Cop Station in Zarelli. Steal it.
Good work, Gecko. Get your ass over to the Train Station in Avalon and meet Shady, the soon-to-be-dead snitch.
Use the horn, Gecko. He doesn't know it's you.
Take Shady to the Zaibatsu Car Crusher in North-East Zarelli.
Get out of the Cop Car, Gecko, and let the crane take over.
Keeping the Zaibatsu Way secure is a full-time job, Gecko. Here's $20,000 for a job well done.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: COP CAR CRUSH!

missions.done_text: You are in error. This Zaibatsu job has already been completed.

plan.text: WHEELER-DEALING!
Hey, Gecko! Trey Welsh here. The Yakuza are flooding the streets with cheap merchandise. I need you to supply my dealers - FAST. Collect the new shipment and get moving!
Move swiftly, Gecko, and watch the clock! You only have THREE minutes to get this shit on the street!
Faster, Gecko! Three to go and people need blow.
Tick tock goes the clock, two deals to go on this block.
Three down, one to go. Come on, Gecko - move it!
You drive like the wind, Gecko. I think we can make further use of your services. In the meantime take $20,000 for your trouble.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: WHEELER-DEALING!

missions.done_text: You are in error. This Zaibatsu job has already been completed.

plan.text: LICK THOSE LOONIES!
Trey Welsh here. The Loonies have slipped narcotics in the water supply and hit my drugs business. Revenge will be simple. First, you need a special Loony Dementia.
You need $5,000 to get the car rigged - so start working!
OK, Gecko, here's the plan... Take the Dementia to the Bomb Shop and rig it with explosives. Then return the rigged Dementia to the Loony Garage and blow the Loons to the Moon.
The party's over in Crazy Town, Gecko. Dump the rigged Dementia in the Loony Garage and set the explosives.
Shit, Gecko, a group of crack Loonies are on their way. You need reinforcements - and fast. Take the Van and meet the Z-Men at North-West Zarelli.
Now go pick up the Z-Men.
The Z-Men will get in the Van when you blast the horn.
Excellent, Gecko, you got the Z-Men. Now head for the Loony Garage and nail that band of crazies!
I like your style, Gecko! Such professionalism in the face of adversity deserves to receive $40,000.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: LICK THOSE LOONIES!

missions.done_text: You are in error. This Zaibatsu job has already been completed.

plan.text: YUTES MUST DIE!
Trey Welsh here. The small-time Yute gang is getting cocky, crushing our new Zaibatsu cars for scrap. I want answers. There's a snitch called Lefty by the Casino. Find out what he knows.
That's Lefty! Beat the son-of-a-bitch until he tells us where his Boss is hiding. But don't kill him until he talks, Gecko!
Settle down, tough guy! The bloke you need is relaxing at the Easy Rider Whore House.
Steal a Yute Car from the South Docks, Gecko - and don't take no shit.
Was that fun? Now move it to the Easy Rider Whore House!
Sound the horn, Gecko. The dumb Yute will think his driver has come to collect him.
It seems someone bigger is behind the car crushing, Gecko. Bring the Yute Boss to Zaibatsu HQ and we will use electrode therapy to find out what he knows.
Good work, Gecko - you got the Yute Boss! Now bring him and the Yute Car to Zaibatsu headquarters. And make sure they both stay in one piece.
Stay in the car, Gecko, while our friend gets out to talk.
We got what we wanted. Take our friend to the South Docks and show him how his Car Crusher works first-hand.
Get out of the car and let the crane do the work, Gecko. But don't go anywhere. Watch and learn how Zaibatsu recycle their waste.
Erradicating these childish threats is a constant problem, Gecko. But now you are richer by $40,000.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: YUTES MUST DIE!

missions.done_text: You are in error. This Zaibatsu job has already been completed.

plan.text: ARMORED CAR CLASH!
Hey, Gecko! Our Latin Biologist Doctor Cubana is being tortured for information in one of two Yakuza cars circling the city. Destroy the cars, before he squeals.
People can always be replaced but secrets cannot. Excellent work, Gecko - well worth $60,000.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: ARMORED CAR CLASH!

missions.done_text: You already did this job, fruitcake!

plan.text: RADIO ZA-ZA!
Hey, Jumbo, it's Elmo. A new Zaibatsu drug mixed with Futuro FM's music is sending people CRAZY. This is bad for our Loony reputation. Get some explosives and stop this madness NOW.
The Zaibatsu are expecting you, Jumbo, so avoid the main gates. Find a back door and dump the explosives by the generator.
Cool, you got the explosives. It's a RIOT at Futuro FM, pay them a visit Jumbo and crisp the DJ.
Shift ass, Jumbo. You got FIVE seconds till she blows!
Drug-induced madness was a cheap corporate cash-in but you saw through it, Jumbo. Here's $20,000. Let's get wasted!
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: RADIO ZA-ZA!

missions.done_text: You already did this job, fruitcake!

plan.text: PIZZA CAKE!
Jumbo! It's me, Elmo. Pizza Cake restaurants keep screwing up my favorite food. Go to the City University, pick up some explosives and teach them a new recipe.
Okay, Jumbo, deliver the explosives by hand to Pizza Cake. And don't forget to run away...
You got FIVE seconds before the dynamite blows. RUN!
So much for those shitty explosives. Wait! A Pizza Cake Delivery Truck is on its way. Destroy that instead.
You follow bad plans well, Jumbo. Have a deep-fried Pizza Cake and $20,000 to celebrate.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: PIZZA CAKE!

missions.done_text: You already did this job, fruitcake!

plan.text: WHO'S MAD?
Hey, Jumbo! You should meet Cosmo Trouble, Downtown. He's got a bonkers mad job for you!
Jumbo, it's me, Elmo. That call was a hoax. Your ass has been set up by my bonkers mad brother who's sent three serious hitmen after you. You'd better kill them - quick!
Maybe you ain't so crazy, Jumbo, 'cos those hitmen are all history. Here's $40,000.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: WHO'S MAD?

missions.done_text: You already did this job, fruitcake!

plan.text: DESTROY J-LAB!
Yo, Jumbo, it's Elmo. New Yakuza drugs are making the insane sane - which is bad news for us Loonies. Pick up explosives from the University and use them to wreak havoc at J-Lab.
Climb the stairs and watch the fun, Jumbo. J-Lab is about to close permanently!
Oh yes, baby, watch it blow! Flaming narcotics are my favorite firework.
The J-Lab is history and the Loonies are safe in insanity. You are one real cool cat, Jumbo. Maybe we do business some other day. For now, here's $40,000.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: DESTROY J-LAB!

missions.done_text: You already did this job, fruitcake!

plan.text: TAXI DRIVERS MUST DIE!
Hey, Jumbo, it's Elmo. The Taxis in this city won't give me a ride. I have chosen three of them for special attention. Go get the first Taxi.
Do your worst, Jumbo. Taxi Drivers must DIE!
Now take the Taxi to the South Docks Car Crusher and get it crushed.
Get out of the Taxi and enjoy the Crusher Magic, Jumbo.
Uh-oh, wrong Car Crusher, Jumbo. You made me look like a fool and that's hard to do!
JOB FAILED!

missions.title: TAXI DRIVERS MUST DIE!

plan.text: TUTORIAL!
Hey there, stranger! Welcome to the Downtown District. Stick around if you wanna learn what's going down...
Apart from neutral areas like this one, the city is carved up between three feuding gangs - the Zaibatsu in grey, the Loonies in green, and the Yakuza in blue.
You need transportation and a weapon to get started in this city - and I'm giving you both. There's the car... and there's a pistol inside.
You wanna see where the gangs operate? Follow the big pink marker to the Zaibatsu zone and look out for the men in grey suits. Some of them drive distinct Z-Type cars.
The next stop is Loony Land, home to the guys in bright green nightdresses. Their cars are obvious from the smiling faces on top.
Now let's visit the Yakuza territory. These fellas dress sharp in the latest blue collection from Milan - and they don't mess around. So be cool.
Now you can see how the city's sliced follow the big pink marker back to me. I got a little somethin' for ya...
I don't know much but I taught you all I know. Here's my S-Uzi Machine Gun - plus a Special Token for your trouble.

briefs: The grey markers will always point to the nearest Zaibatsu phones where jobs may be found for those with sufficient respect.
Tell your friends! The Zaibatsu Corporation is interested in offering contract work to anyone prepared to keep the Loony population to a minimum.
The blue markers always point to the nearest Yakuza phone where jobs are made available for anyone with enough respect.
You want Yakuza respect you better start killing Zaibatsu. Simple. The reasons - you will learn!
Whoop-whoop! The green markers always point to the nearest Loony phones where jobs may be found - just so long as you have the respect.
Hoo-hoo! We Loonies respect people who like killing Yakuza poops.

missions.done_text: This job was most peacefully completed.

plan.text: DECONSTRUCTION YARD!
Grasshopper - it's Sunbeam. The Zaibatsu are building Shopping Malls on Holy Krishna land. Pay a visit to their Construction Yard and end the destruction.
They locked the Construction Yard Gateway, Grasshopper, and now only Leo The Locksmith can open it. You should find him doing a job on the Water Towers.
Okay, shorty, show me the Gateway.
You destroyed the Generator, shorty! Okay, show me this Gateway.
Stand back, shorty, while I open this Gateway.
Get into the Construction Yard and kill the Zaibatsu Construction Manager.
Well done, Grasshopper, you halted construction! Your reward is $40,000. Join us in song - we have temples to build!
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: DECONSTRUCTION YARD!

missions.done_text: This job was most peacefully completed.

plan.text: COP CAR SCRAP!
Ah, Grasshopper, it's Sunbeam. The Krishna program of automotive clearance has been halted by the Cops. Steal me a Cop Car so we can resume our work!
Joy to you, Grasshopper! Here's $40,000. We will enjoy a full-on naked Krishna festival in your honor. Keep in touch.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: COP CAR SCRAP!

missions.done_text: This job was most peacefully completed.

plan.text: KILL INTRUDERS ON SIGHT!

missions.title: bil_km1

missions.done_text: This job was most peacefully completed.

plan.text: SUNBEAM CONTRACT!
Ah, Grasshopper! Sunbeam here. I have a very fun job for you. Go meet some loyal Krishna converts and I will tell you more.
The Russian Kovski have put out a contract on the Grand Master. Seek out and destroy the Russian Assassins!
With the Grand Master safe we have many nubile young converts awaiting your attention, Grasshopper. In the meantime, have $60,000.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: SUNBEAM CONTRACT!

missions.done_text: This job was most peacefully completed.

plan.text: ROOFTOP RESCUE!
Ah, Grasshopper - Sunbeam here. My Faithful Krishna are captive at the Zaibatsu Power Plant. Free them and Krishna will smile upon you.
Follow us, Grasshopper! We know where to find transportation.
Now that we have found transport, Grasshopper, you must lead us to the Safehouse. Use the other Limousine - we will follow.
It seems that our path is blocked by danger, Grasshopper. Only you can clear a way!
It would be foolish to try to leave while the way is still blocked, Grasshopper.
My Faithful Krishna are dead, Grasshopper! You must leave. I must meditate.
JOB FAILED!

missions.title: ROOFTOP RESCUE!

missions.done_text: Idiot! This Zaibatsu job has already been completed!

plan.text: IT WAS AN ACCIDENT!
Hey, Gecko, it's Uno Carb. I need you to neutralize THREE Key Operatives from rival outfits. First you need to collect a Special Package...
Excellent, Gecko, you have the Special Package. Be VERY careful - it is highly unstable.
Deliver the Special Package to Bilovski, the crazed Russian weapons pervert.
Success, Gecko! You need a Hot Dog Van to execute the second part of this job.
The target will be waiting for your Hot Dog Van, Gecko. Note that these hot dogs are poisoned...
Very clean, Gecko. Now we have a Russian to dispose of... Meet your Z-Contact on the roof.
I rigged a Kovski Limousine to be remote-controlled. Drive it into the Russian area.
The Kovski are looking for this Limousine - it was stolen only a few hours ago!
The trap is set, Gecko. Lead the Russian Limousine into the Krishna quarter.
Don't move the Limousine, Gecko. Instead watch a perfectly executed Zaibatsu trap...
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: IT WAS AN ACCIDENT!

missions.done_text: Idiot! This Zaibatsu job has already been completed!

plan.text: GRAND THEFT AUTO!
Hey, Gecko, it's me, Uno Carb. If you fancy causing some trouble, try stealing the Jefferson down at Krishna Krushers.
The car is on the island near the Docks, Gecko. The only available access is via these rooftops.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: GRAND THEFT AUTO!

missions.done_text: Idiot! This Zaibatsu job has already been completed!

plan.text: PAYBACK!
Hey, Gecko, it's Uno Carb. I'm selling LEGAL drugs on the black market for twice the price. If you want in on the deal, go meet Ziggy Pole.
Bah. Tell Uno the Kovski want better play-drugs - like the new Mitsi.
The next guy is fast moving up the Zaibatsu ranks. He should pose no problems, Gecko!
Hi, you must be Gecko. Want a Mitsi? No? Well you'd better get this cash back to Uno.
Keep moving, Gecko. A high-ranking Kovski is the next dealer and he might prove difficult.
I have no money for Zaibatsu punks! Tell Uno Carb to go screw himself!
Kill the Kovski cash-dodger and his pathetic little gang, Gecko.
The last dealer's a real loose cannon - so be cool, Gecko.
Look, man, I'm being tailed. I can't talk. My mute handler will pass you the green.
Excellent, Gecko, you got the money. Now zoom down to the Brown-Eye Sewage Works and steal a Kovski Truck by way of payment.
The Kovski Truck contains contraband reactor fuel that we could utilize. Steal the Truck to teach the Russians a lesson.
The front door is secure. Find a way in around the back and then destroy the old Soviet Generators on the inside to open the entrance.
Congratulations, Gecko! You have succeeded in completing ALL the Zaibatsu jobs!
ALL ZAIBATSU JOBS DONE!

missions.title: PAYBACK!

missions.done_text: Idiot! This Zaibatsu job has already been completed!

plan.text: LOCK-OUT!
Gecko - it's Uno Carb. The Russians have taken a Truck full of Zaibatsu AI Brain Units. Steal the whole lot back from the Tedium Docks.
As expected the entrance is locked, Gecko. Try the back door!
My intelligence was poor - the back door is also locked. I will program Satchmo The Safecracker to meet you. Get moving!
Show me the lock, Z-Man, and let my fingers do their magic.
I hear a clock! Stand back in case the door's booby-trapped.
Satchmo was getting old anyway. Now steal a Kovski Bulwark and try to enter using Zaibatsu stealth!
Excellent, you are inside, Gecko. Now steal back my AI Brain Unit Truck.
Congratulations, Gecko! You have succeeded in completing ALL the Zaibatsu jobs!
ALL ZAIBATSU JOBS DONE!

missions.title: LOCK-OUT!

missions.done_text: Idiot! This Zaibatsu job has already been completed!

plan.text: I'D LIKE A TANK PLEASE, BOB!
Gecko - it's Uno Carb. The City Security Services are getting too big for their boots so we need to show them the Zaibatsu still mean business. Bring me a SWAT Van.
Next we need a Special Agent Car. Go, Gecko - GO!
Excellent. Gecko, you are the only Operative I know with the balls to steal a Tank. What are you waiting for?
That little demonstration of power has wiped the smug smiles from the faces of the Security Forces. Here's $80,000 for a job well done.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: I'D LIKE A TANK PLEASE, BOB!

missions.done_text: This contract has already been fulfilled!

plan.text: HOT DOG HOMICIDE!
Comrade! Jerkov here! A leading meat processing plant will make special hot dogs to feed my troops if I supply the meat. Steal a Bus and pick up people from Bus Stops.
Good work, Comrade! Supervise the mincing from the top of The Cage.
Stay on The Cage, Comrade. We need to make sure the passengers are processed.
Why did you leave, Comrade? We could not contain the crazed passengers and now we cannot make enough hot dogs to feed my troops. This job is over.
JOB FAILED!

missions.title: HOT DOG HOMICIDE!

missions.done_text: This contract has already been fulfilled!

plan.text: MMM, RUSSIAN SAILORS!
Hey, Comrade, it's Jerkov! Zaibatsu Dealers are cutting in on our drug trade. Collect the Z-Type we have parked and help us redress the balance.
At last we are doing great street business - thanks to you, Comrade. We will work together again I am sure. For now, here is $40,000.
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: MMM, RUSSIAN SAILORS!

missions.done_text: This contract has already been fulfilled!

plan.text: OFFICER DOWN!
Jerkov here, Comrade. Police protection is a big earner - and I want a slice of that pie. You have FIVE minutes to destroy TWO Cop Cars and disrupt the marketplace.
Health insurance just went up thanks to you, Comrade. Now I want to start getting serious... Destroy a SWAT Van!
You make this look easy, Comrade! Finally, we also intend to compete with the Government - so that means you need to destroy TWO Special Agent Cars!
The City's Emergency Services are troubled thanks to you, Comrade. Take this $60,000 with our gratitude and drink to continued Kovski success!
JOB COMPLETE!

missions.title: OFFICER DOWN!

missions.done_text: This contract has already been fulfilled!

plan.text: KARMA ASSASSINS!
Hey, Comrade - it's Jerkov. The Karma Assassins are coming and all my good Kovski are drunk. You must protect me!
Outstanding, Comrade! You helped the Karma Assassins to meet their maker!
Top Karma Assassin Nova Bright lies in wait in an Armored Bus. Eradicate him, Comrade!
Fantastic, Comrade! You have completed ALL the Russian jobs!
ALL RUSSIAN JOBS DONE!

missions.title: KARMA ASSASSINS!

missions.done_text: This contract has already been fulfilled!

plan.text: VEDIC MASSACRE!
Hey, Comrade, it's Jerkov. Krishna free love is bankrupting my bitch action. Find Ivan and his mercenary friends to spill some free blood.
Fantastic, Comrade! You have completed ALL the Russian jobs!
ALL RUSSIAN JOBS DONE!

missions.title: VEDIC MASSACRE!

briefs: The Zaibatsu hate the Krishna. Kill the Krishna to earn our respect!
Welcome, Comrade, to the Russian Mafia!
The Russian Mafia hate the Capitalist Zaibatsu! Kill the Zaibatsu and we will respect you.

plan.text: FINAL JOB!
Congratulations, kid! Your activities have seriously upset the Russian, Krishna AND Zaibatsu Bosses and now they ALL want you wiped off the face of the city!
The three Bosses are on a personal crusade to nail your ass to the floor. You ain't got no choice but to kill them or be killed.
JOB COMPLETE!
OUTSTANDING! You wasted all three Bosses! Shit, that's gotta be some kinda achievement!

missions.done_text: You already took this job and finished it!

plan.text: SINK OR SWIM!
Hello, THC-303, it's Dr LaBrat. Zaibatsu Operatives have secret SRS data and I want it back. Steal a Taxi and keep it in one piece - too much destruction will alert the Cops.

missions.title: SINK OR SWIM!

missions.done_text: You already took this job and finished it!

plan.text: FAKE TRUCE!
Ah, THC-303. Dr LaBrat here. The Zaibatsu and Rednecks want a peace meeting so I'm taking the opportunity to perform an experiment. Collect the old Factory Bus and I will unravel my plan.

missions.title: FAKE TRUCE!

missions.done_text: You already took this job and finished it!

plan.text: LABRAT'S PLAN!
Ah, THC-303! Dr LaBrat here. SRS research suggests the Zaibatsu population is on the rise. Please visit The Village and reduce their number to a more acceptable statistical median.
Wonderful work, THC-303 - worthy of $50,000.
Mission Complete!

missions.title: LABRAT'S PLAN!

missions.done_text: You already took this job and finished it!

plan.text: GRAN'PA WE LOVE YOU!
Hello, THC-303, it's Dr LaBrat. The Professor wants to experiment on a Redneck and has chosen the one they call Gran'pa. First you need to win their confidence...
Head over to the Opry Car Park and meet with Gran'pa's grandson Dirk. You need his Pickup to kidnap Gran'pa.
Hey there, City Boy! You here to race? Anyone who beats mah record fer huntin' down and killin' THREE escaped Loonies wins mah Pickup.
Take your pick from these fine automobiles and the clock will start to tick!
Drive fast, City Boy, and you might just get mah Pickup. Don't bother tryin' to get out of that car - the doors are locked shut! Hoo-hah!
Fantastic, THC-303. Bring Gran'pa to the Research Center - in one piece. Do not let the Rednecks catch you.
Smooth, THC-303. You are a cool operator. Please accept $50,000 with our thanks for all your hard work.
Mission Complete!

missions.title: GRAN'PA WE LOVE YOU!

missions.done_text: You already took this job and finished it!

plan.text: TAXI TRAITOR TEST!
Hello, THC-303, it's Dr LaBrat. Our prototype remote-control Taxi needs a good operator - like you. If you perform well further work will be made available.
Think you can handle test-driving the remote-control Taxi around town? Well that's the job.
We need you to pick up THREE suspected SRS Traitors, THC-303. Off you go - get the first one.
Mission Complete!
It's a pleasure to watch you work, THC-303. You deserve this $70,000.

missions.title: TAXI TRAITOR TEST!

missions.done_text: DEAD BRIEF

plan.text: SCIENCE FRICTION!
Gecko! Red Valdez here. I need you to bomb the SRS Clone Test Center so it looks like a Redneck attack. Montana's Pickup is loaded with lethal explosives. Steal it.
Mission Complete!
Holy shit, Gecko! What a BANG! What a BLAST! Have $30,000 for a job well done.

missions.title: SCIENCE FRICTION!

missions.done_text: DEAD BRIEF

plan.text: FIRE TRUCK FUN!
Gecko! Red Valdez here. A new SRS Flamethrower is being transported across the city in an SRS Security Van - and I want it.
The Security Van has a new locking mechanism which can't be opened by conventional methods. The driver might be persuaded to get out by the Cops...
OK, Gecko, here's the deal - steal a Cop Car.
Fantastic, Gecko. This particular Flamethrower will only operate in conjunction with a Fire Truck. So what are you waiting for? Go get a Fire Truck!
Now the new Fire Truck is ready let's put it to the test! Head for Mobile RV and barbecue at least 30 Rednecks!
Mission Complete!

missions.title: FIRE TRUCK FUN!

missions.done_text: DEAD BRIEF

plan.text: OPERATION Z!
Gecko - it's Red Valdez. The Rednecks and Scientists are moving new contraband around this city and I want it ALL. I want you to bring me FOUR loaded vehicles.
There's a Pickup full of pills at the Redneck Bowling Alley. Go get it, Gecko.
The guards are wasted on Beany Liquor, Gecko, but Disgracelands is still tough to breach.
Mission Complete!

missions.title: OPERATION Z!

missions.done_text: DEAD BRIEF

plan.text: VALDEZ ALERT!
Gecko - Red Valdez here. I want you to infiltrate the SRS Research Center and destroy their Cold Fusion Generators. Some Z-Men will join you shortly.
Access to the Research Center appears impossible but we have found a way - over a line of rooftop ramps and then on to and along the old Railway Track.
There are Anti-Blast Suit Dispensers on the walkways leading to each Generator, Gecko. You can't miss them. But beware the SRS Guards - they won't be so forgiving.
Well done, Gecko. Cold Fusion will remain a laboratory myth. Have $50,000. Stay in touch!
Mission Complete!

missions.title: VALDEZ ALERT!

missions.done_text: DEAD BRIEF

plan.text: MURDER IN THE MALL!
Ah, Gecko! Red Valdez here. I'm curious to see how well you handle extreme situations. Some Z-Men will join you shortly. Your destination is The Mall.
Commendable combat skills, Gecko! Here's $70,000 in recognition of your ruthlessness.
Mission Complete!

missions.title: MURDER IN THE MALL!

missions.done_text: Shit-head! You already done this job!

plan.text: BLOW JOB!
Hey, Rooster, it's Billy Bob Bean. Montana has wired some new explosives to the ass of a Pickup and I want you to collect it.
This is makin' progress, Rooster. Montana has another Pickup rigged to do some damage. Go 'n' get it.
Yee-ha! Them Zaibatsu don't know what hit 'em! Here's $30,000. Keep this up and you could end up one of the Good Ol' Boys. An' there's always plenty work for them, Rooster.
Mission Complete!

plan.text: BENSON BURNER!

Deliver this Benson safe, Rooster, and I might just give you a shot at ma' Mary-Joe Bean.
Let's see Montana's fireworks roast this Pig! Squeal, little piggy!

plan.text: GANG CAR BANG!
Rooster! Billy Bob here! Me an' the boys are lookin' fer fun down SRS way. You bein' a Good Ol' Boy an' all you wanna join in the fun? First to destroy five Meteors is The King!

missions.title: GANG CAR BANG!

briefs: You are talking to the Zaibatsu. You can probably see some of us now - the cool-looking characters dressed in grey.
You want our respect? Try disposing of filthy Rednecks!
This here's the Rednecks, boy! You might be lookin' at some of us now - the fine-lookin' folk with gorgeous red hair.
You want our respect? You waste some of them smart-ass Scientists!

plan.text: Nice work, kiddo! Now the Redneck, SRS AND Zaibatsu Bosses are ALL out for your ass!
Incredible! You beat all three of them! You'd better move your sorry ass out to the city's Industrial District before things get any worse.
